facet_coverage.decision: Version/namespace distinction and hierarchy consistency are explicit; compatibility failures are explained rather than silently reinterpreted.
Rank/order/unique names/dimension_names and absent-axis controls are covered. Explicit absent-dimension versus length-one dimension navigation behavior is not specified.
Group-relative declared paths, largest-first order, per-level transforms and missing-level handling are covered. Reader selection heuristics remain proposals.

Sequential dataset then multiscales transforms, scale before translation and unknown/relative calibration are covered. There is no concrete numeric check combining offsets and group transforms that exposes reversed composition.

Discovery paths, permitted nesting, parity and transform-aware geometry are covered. But deep source.image resolution is expressly left unresolved and a source-association check before overlay is not made concrete; passing a link and displaying it is not a resolved association contract.

Integer dtypes and label-value keyed metadata are stated; neither report specifies exact uint64/int64 identity preservation or an exact supported range, nor categorical resampling that avoids creating IDs. Palette SHOULD is correctly not a universal styling MUST.

current_only_comparison: Both reports preserve substantial version/namespace, axes/dimension_names, pyramid ordering and transform rules. Both lack an offset-sensitive numeric transform oracle and exact categorical precision/resampling treatment; singleton-vs-absent dimension behavior is not made explicit. R006 more directly specifies label source-image resolution/mismatch and geometry fallback. R005 has materially incorrect normative force/reader-policy derivations, well.version mandatory-presence error and capability/conformance conflation. R006 has two false unit vocabulary counts (source 26 space, 23 time; report 25 and 19). Neither earns a same-quality pass.
qualification: Current semantic comparison only; no acquisition preservation, cost, latency, treatment interpretation or integrated qualification adjudicated. Visible embedded labels/budgets are a recorded blinding limitation. Faster incomplete output cannot establish a quality win.
